risks.risk: Not working (heating element or fan may be dead or weak). Photos don’t confirm power-on or airflow/heating.
risks.proof: A short video of the dryer plugged in and switched on showing: fan blowing and heat warming (or temperature/heat indicator if present).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not working / needs repair until proven otherwise.

risks.risk: Electrical safety issues (damaged cable/plug, loose wiring, tripping). Not visible clearly in photos.
risks.proof: Clear close-up photos of the plug and entire cable length + a video showing it runs without sparking/odour and without tripping a breaker.

risks.risk: Missing parts/accessories (attachments, nozzles, filters, or the correct handle/hood components). Photos may not show completeness.
risks.proof: Photo of everything included laid out on a surface, plus a close-up of the attachment points showing they fit properly.

risks.risk: Age/wear may reduce performance (weak airflow, uneven heating). Photos can’t show performance level.
risks.proof: Video test showing consistent airflow and heat for a few minutes (not just a quick flash).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as average/weak performance due to used condition.

proof_requests: Send a short power-on video showing it heats and blows air continuously for at least 2–3 minutes.
Send clear close-ups of the plug and the full cable (no cuts/burn marks).
Confirm what accessories are included (any nozzles/attachments/stand parts) with a photo of all items together.
response.reason: The item type and brand label are visible, but there’s no proof it works or is electrically safe. For a hair dryer, functionality and heating are the main value drivers, so the price should wait for a power-on test.
